description: This file contains shell script code that tests git archive attribute patterns and their behavior when including or excluding files and directories based on attributes. It defines test scenarios, sets up a repository with various attribute configurations, and verifies the behavior of 'git archive' with respect to ignore patterns.

methods.name: test_expect_exists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists, expects success if present.

methods.name: test_expect_missing
methods.description: Checks if a file does not exist, expects success if absent.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test sequences.
